label: 01-vcenter-version
note: Authenticated vSphere Client summary shows vCenter 8.0.3 build 24674346.

label: 02-esxi-host-version
note: Target host connected; vCenter UI shows ESXi 8.0.3 build 24280767.

label: 03-pci-disabled
note: All PCI devices view: A and B Disabled before vCenter UI selection.

label: 04-only-a-selected
note: vCenter UI: checking A leaves B unchecked; selection count is 1. This differs from Host Client immediate checkbox expansion.

label: 05-host-toggle-complete
note: Only A was checked in vCenter UI; Toggle Passthrough completed, and backend readback confirms both A and B enabled/active. No separate dependency dialog was observed.

label: 06-vm-a-static-selection
note: Selected only static DirectPath IO A, not the separate Dynamic DirectPath IO entry.

label: 07-vm-a-one-device-before-save
note: Only static A appears in the VM editor. Expanded details show a generic passthrough operations note, not a dependency-specific warning.

label: 08-vm-a-saved
note: VM-A editor submission result and saved PCI panel captured; backend collector verifies exact backing.

label: excluded-navigation-editor-race
note: After navigating toward B, the old A editor opened before the view settled. The B-specific guard prevented any addition; canceled A without changes.

label: 09-vm-b-static-selection
note: B remains selectable in a second VM after A was saved in VM-A. Static DirectPath IO B selected.

label: 10-vm-b-one-device-before-save
note: VM-B contains only B before save; expanded details show generic operations note, no dependency-specific prompt observed.

label: 11-vm-b-saved
note: vCenter Reconfigure task completed for B-only configuration; backend confirms A=1, B=1, BOTH=0 devices.

label: 12-vm-both-two-devices-before-save
note: Explicitly added static A and static B to the same VM; editor shows two separate PCI devices.

label: 13-vm-both-saved
note: Same-VM A+B Reconfigure task completed; backend confirms 2 static devices.

label: 14-vm-a-powered-on
note: vCenter UI first power-on completed; API readback confirms A poweredOn, B and BOTH poweredOff.

label: 15-vm-b-power-on-failed
note: vCenter GUI power-on for B failed while A remained running; backend Datacenter.ExecuteVmPowerOnLRO task confirms error.

label: 16-vm-a-powered-off
note: Power-off task completed and backend confirms all test VMs off before reversing start order.

label: 17-vm-b-first-powered-on
note: B now powers on successfully after A was released.

label: 18-vm-a-reverse-power-on-failed
note: With B running, A GUI power-on failed; backend confirms A off and B on.

label: 19-vm-b-powered-off
note: B is powered off; all three test VMs off before same-VM A+B start.

label: 20-vm-both-power-on-failed
note: Same-VM A+B power-on failed with DevicePowerOn; API final readback confirms all test VMs powered off. Recent Tasks filtered to failures for readability.
